theorem.source: (Sigma,L,p), with Sigma a W33 spread, L outside Sigma, p on L
theorem.forward: M is the unique Sigma-line through p; N is the unique line meeting M and disjoint from L with owner_Sigma(N)=owner_Sigma(L)
theorem.inverse: Sigma is the unique spread containing M with owner_Sigma(L)=owner_Sigma(N); p=L intersect M

four_three_flag_tower.base: 1080 active pairs (Sigma,L) with L outside Sigma
four_three_flag_tower.base_stabilizer: S4, faithful on the four points of L
four_three_flag_tower.first_fibre: choose p on L: index 4, stabilizer S3, canonically produces one ordered path
four_three_flag_tower.second_fibre: the three path completions correspond to the three points of L other than p
four_three_flag_tower.subgroup_chain: S3 < S4 with index 4; S3 acts faithfully on the three completions
